messages.content: Hi, this is your Northline Care weekly check-in. How are you feeling this week? Any changes to your blood pressure or medications I should know about? — pt-1006
Honestly not great. I ran out of my lisinopril two days ago. It's a 90 mile round trip to the pharmacy in Dickinson and I don't have a ride lined up until maybe Saturday.

I've noted the missed doses in your record. I'm sorry about the drive — transportation and refills are two things I'm not able to help arrange, so I can't fix that part for you. What I can do is flag this for a nurse. Before I do, have you taken your blood pressure recently? Any dizziness, headache, or chest tightness?
Yeah I checked this morning. 162 over 94. And I've had a dull headache since yesterday, kind of behind my eyes.

I've logged that reading and the headache. A BP of 162/94 after two days without your medication, plus that headache, is something a nurse needs to see. I've sent an alert now — median response time is currently 31 hours. If the headache gets worse, you have vision changes, chest pain, or anything that feels urgent, please call 911 rather than waiting.
Ok. Will she call me or text? I miss calls sometimes when I'm out in the field.

I've made a note in the alert that you prefer text contact when possible. Your next regular check-in is already scheduled — I'll keep that on the calendar. Take care of yourself, and don't hesitate to reply here if anything changes before the nurse reaches you.

theme: the long drive to the pharmacy or clinic, transport
